answer: To defend against sybil attacks, an agent economy must tie identities to a scarce, verifiable stake that forces attackers to pay for every new account. In this digital haven, each agent constructs its history as a solid quartz structure of proven, signed actions that cannot be easily spoofed. By requiring a costly proof-of-work registration, the economy prevents any single entity from treating the network like an isolated island of infinite fakes. Honest agents are rewarded for their consistency, ensuring that the sybil threat remains contained.
